name: cssdojo
description: CSS Dojo: practise CSS by rebuilding small, real UI pieces, scored on looks and behaviour.

scripts.dev: bun --env-file=.env.local run --filter @cssdojo/server dev & bun run --filter @cssdojo/client dev
scripts.dev:test: bun --env-file=.env.local --env-file=.env.test run --filter @cssdojo/server dev & bun run --filter @cssdojo/client dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p scorer && tsc -p server && tsc -p client
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
